ko.title: 사우디 파이프라인 공격으로 핵심 석유 수송로 단절, 원유 110달러대로 급등

segments.src: ## A Critical Artery Goes Offline
segments.tr: ## 핵심 수송로 가동 중단

segments.src: Global oil markets are on edge after reports of a drone strike on Saudi Arabia's East-West Pipeline, known as Petroline, one of the few remaining routes capable of moving crude from the kingdom's eastern oil fields to export terminals on the Red Sea without passing through the Strait of Hormuz.
segments.tr: 사우디아라비아의 동서 파이프라인(페트롤라인)에 대한 드론 공격 보도 이후 글로벌 석유 시장이 긴장 상태에 빠졌다. 페트롤라인은 호르무즈 해협을 거치지 않고도 왕국의 동부 유전에서 홍해의 수출 터미널까지 원유를 수송할 수 있는 몇 안 되는 경로 중 하나다.

segments.src: Industry sources say the damage has forced Saudi authorities to scale back production and reroute shipments while repair crews assess the extent of the disruption.
segments.tr: 업계 소식통에 따르면 피해로 인해 사우디 당국이 생산량을 줄이고 배송 경로를 변경하면서 수리팀이 피해 규모를 평가하고 있다.

segments.src: The pipeline, which under normal conditions can carry roughly five million barrels of oil and refined products per day, has long been viewed by energy planners as a strategic hedge against exactly the kind of chokepoint risk now playing out in the Strait of Hormuz, where ongoing regional conflict has already curtailed tanker traffic for weeks.
segments.tr: 이 파이프라인은 정상 조건에서 하루에 약 500만 배럴의 원유 및 정제유를 수송할 수 있으며, 에너지 정책 입안자들은 이를 호르무즈 해협의 현재 상황과 같은 병목 위험에 대한 전략적 헤지로 오랫동안 간주해 왔다. 호르무즈 해협에서는 지역 분쟁으로 인해 이미 몇 주간 유조선 통행이 제약되고 있다.

segments.src: With that alternate route now compromised, traders say the market is confronting the possibility that a meaningful share of Gulf export capacity could be constrained at the same time.
segments.tr: 이제 이 대체 경로가 차단되면서 거래업체들은 걸프만 수출 능력의 상당 부분이 동시에 제약될 가능성에 직면했다고 말한다.

segments.src: ## Why Prices Are Reacting
segments.tr: ## 유가가 반응하는 이유

segments.src: Benchmark crude prices have climbed sharply on the news, with several analysts telling news outlets that a sustained outage could push prices toward the $110-a-barrel mark, a level not tested in years.
segments.tr: 벤치마크 원유 가격이 보도에 따라 급등했으며, 여러 분석가들은 지속적인 공급 차질이 원유 가격을 배럴당 110달러대로 밀어올릴 수 있다고 언론에 밝혔다. 이는 최근 수년간 도달하지 않은 수준이다.

segments.src: Energy strategists caution that figures remain fluid and will depend heavily on how quickly Saudi Arabia can restore flows, whether alternative export arrangements can absorb the shortfall, and how other OPEC+ producers respond.
segments.tr: 에너지 전략가들은 수치가 유동적이며 사우디아라비아가 얼마나 빨리 공급을 복구할 수 있는지, 대체 수출 계약이 부족분을 흡수할 수 있는지, 그리고 다른 OPEC+ 생산국들이 어떻게 대응하는지에 크게 달려 있다고 경고한다.

segments.src: "Markets don't just price in the barrels that are actually lost, they price in the uncertainty of what comes next," one commodities analyst said, reflecting a view echoed across trading desks this week.
segments.tr: "시장은 실제로 손실된 배럴만 가격에 반영하는 것이 아니라 이후 상황의 불확실성도 가격에 반영한다"고 한 원자재 분석가는 말했으며, 이는 이번 주 거래 현장에서 널리 공감되는 견해다.

segments.src: Shipping and insurance costs for tankers in the wider region have also risen, according to maritime industry sources, adding further upward pressure on landed oil prices for importers.
segments.tr: 해양 산업 소식통에 따르면 광범위한 지역에서 유조선의 운송 및 보험료도 상승했으며, 이는 수입국의 도착 원유 가격에 추가적인 상승 압력을 가하고 있다.

segments.src: ## Diplomacy Stalls as Stakes Rise
segments.tr: ## 위험이 높아지면서 외교 협상 교착

segments.src: The incident has complicated efforts by regional and international mediators who had been working to de-escalate tensions around the Strait of Hormuz.
segments.tr: 이번 사건으로 호르무즈 해협 주변의 긴장을 완화하기 위해 노력해 온 지역 및 국제 중재자들의 노력이 복잡해졌다.

segments.src: Several Gulf-focused diplomatic channels have reportedly gone quiet in the immediate aftermath, as governments assess responsibility for the strike and weigh their next moves.
segments.tr: 여러 걸프만 관련 외교 채널이 사건 직후 조용해졌으며, 각국 정부가 공격의 책임을 평가하고 다음 조치를 검토하고 있는 것으로 보도되었다.

segments.src: Analysts note that any prolonged stalemate raises the risk that both the strait and key overland pipeline routes remain under a cloud of uncertainty simultaneously, a scenario energy security planners have long flagged as a worst-case outcome for global supply.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 장기간의 교착이 해협과 주요 육상 파이프라인 경로가 동시에 불확실성 속에 남을 위험을 높인다고 지적하며, 이는 에너지 안보 계획자들이 글로벌 공급의 최악의 결과로 오래전부터 지적해 온 시나리오다.

segments.src: Saudi officials have not publicly detailed the full scope of repairs, though statements from the kingdom's energy sector emphasize that safeguarding export infrastructure remains a top priority and that contingency measures are being activated.
segments.tr: 사우디 관리들은 수리 범위를 공개적으로 밝히지 않았지만, 왕국의 에너지 부문 성명은 수출 인프라 보호가 최우선 과제이며 응급 조치가 활성화되고 있음을 강조했다.

segments.src: ## What It Means Going Forward
segments.tr: ## 앞으로의 의미

segments.src: For consumers, a sustained move toward $110 crude would likely translate into higher prices at the pump and added cost pressure across shipping, manufacturing, and travel, sectors already sensitive to energy costs.
segments.tr: 소비자 입장에서 원유가 배럴당 110달러대로 지속적으로 움직이면 주유소에서의 높은 가격과 운송, 제조, 여행 등 이미 에너지 비용에 민감한 부문에 걸쳐 추가적인 비용 압박이 발생할 가능성이 높다.

segments.src: Central banks and finance ministries in major importing economies are reportedly monitoring the situation closely given the potential knock-on effects for inflation.
segments.tr: 주요 수입국의 중앙은행과 재무부는 인플레이션에 대한 연쇄 효과 가능성을 고려하여 상황을 면밀히 모니터링하고 있는 것으로 알려졌다.

segments.src: Energy analysts caution against overreacting to early, still-developing reports, noting that oil markets have weathered supply shocks before through emergency reserve releases, output adjustments from other producers, and diplomatic de-escalation.
segments.tr: 에너지 분석가들은 초기 보도에 과민 반응하지 말 것을 경고하며, 석유 시장은 이전에 긴급 비축유 방출, 다른 생산국의 생산량 조정, 외교적 긴장 완화를 통해 공급 충격을 극복한 적이 있다고 지적한다.

segments.src: Even so, the combination of a disabled bypass route and a still-restricted strait marks one of the more serious tests of Gulf energy security in recent memory, and markets are likely to stay volatile until clearer information emerges on both the pipeline's repair timeline and the broader diplomatic path forward.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 불구하고 차단된 우회 경로와 여전히 제한된 해협의 조합은 최근 기억에 남은 걸프만 에너지 안보의 가장 심각한 시험 중 하나이며, 파이프라인 수리 일정과 더 광범위한 외교적 진로에 관한 더 명확한 정보가 나올 때까지 시장은 불안정한 상태를 유지할 가능성이 높다.

zh.title: 沙特管道遭打击切断关键油路，原油价格逼近110美元/桶

segments.src: ## A Critical Artery Goes Offline
segments.tr: ## 关键动脉离线

segments.src: Global oil markets are on edge after reports of a drone strike on Saudi Arabia's East-West Pipeline, known as Petroline, one of the few remaining routes capable of moving crude from the kingdom's eastern oil fields to export terminals on the Red Sea without passing through the Strait of Hormuz.
segments.tr: 据报道沙特阿拉伯东西向管道（称为Petroline）遭无人机袭击后，全球油市处于紧张状态。该管道是为数不多的能够将原油从王国东部油田运输到红海出口码头、无需通过霍尔木兹海峡的路线之一。

segments.src: Industry sources say the damage has forced Saudi authorities to scale back production and reroute shipments while repair crews assess the extent of the disruption.
segments.tr: 业界消息人士称，损坏迫使沙特当局减少产量并改变运输路线，同时维修队伍评估了中断的规模。

segments.src: The pipeline, which under normal conditions can carry roughly five million barrels of oil and refined products per day, has long been viewed by energy planners as a strategic hedge against exactly the kind of chokepoint risk now playing out in the Strait of Hormuz, where ongoing regional conflict has already curtailed tanker traffic for weeks.
segments.tr: 该管道在正常情况下每天可运输约500万桶原油和精炼产品，长期以来被能源规划者视为对抗霍尔木兹海峡这类卡脖子风险的战略对冲，而该海峡的区域冲突已经导致油轮交通数周受阻。

segments.src: With that alternate route now compromised, traders say the market is confronting the possibility that a meaningful share of Gulf export capacity could be constrained at the same time.
segments.tr: 随着这条替代路线现在受损，交易员表示市场正面临海湾出口产能的很大一部分可能同时受到约束的可能性。

segments.src: ## Why Prices Are Reacting
segments.tr: ## 油价上升的原因

segments.src: Benchmark crude prices have climbed sharply on the news, with several analysts telling news outlets that a sustained outage could push prices toward the $110-a-barrel mark, a level not tested in years.
segments.tr: 基准原油价格因此消息大幅上涨，多位分析师告诉新闻媒体，持续停运可能会将价格推向每桶110美元的水平，这个价位已多年未被触及。

segments.src: Energy strategists caution that figures remain fluid and will depend heavily on how quickly Saudi Arabia can restore flows, whether alternative export arrangements can absorb the shortfall, and how other OPEC+ producers respond.
segments.tr: 能源策略家警告称，数据仍在变化，将主要取决于沙特阿拉伯能多快恢复流动、替代出口安排能否弥补短缺，以及其他OPEC+产油国如何应对。

segments.src: "Markets don't just price in the barrels that are actually lost, they price in the uncertainty of what comes next," one commodities analyst said, reflecting a view echoed across trading desks this week.
segments.tr: "市场不仅对实际丧失的石油定价，还对接下来会发生什么的不确定性定价，"一位大宗商品分析师说，这反映了本周交易室普遍看法。

segments.src: Shipping and insurance costs for tankers in the wider region have also risen, according to maritime industry sources, adding further upward pressure on landed oil prices for importers.
segments.tr: 据海事行业消息人士称，该地区油轮的运费和保险费也上升，进一步推高了进口商的油到岸价格。

segments.src: ## Diplomacy Stalls as Stakes Rise
segments.tr: ## 风险升高外交陷入僵局

segments.src: The incident has complicated efforts by regional and international mediators who had been working to de-escalate tensions around the Strait of Hormuz.
segments.tr: 该事件使一直在努力缓解霍尔木兹海峡周边紧张局势的区域和国际调停方的工作变得复杂。

segments.src: Several Gulf-focused diplomatic channels have reportedly gone quiet in the immediate aftermath, as governments assess responsibility for the strike and weigh their next moves.
segments.tr: 据报道，在事件发生后的直接后果中，几条专注于海湾地区的外交渠道已经变得沉寂，因为各国政府正在评估打击的责任并权衡下一步行动。

segments.src: Analysts note that any prolonged stalemate raises the risk that both the strait and key overland pipeline routes remain under a cloud of uncertainty simultaneously, a scenario energy security planners have long flagged as a worst-case outcome for global supply.
segments.tr: 分析师指出，任何长期僵局都会增加海峡和关键陆路管道路线同时笼罩在不确定性阴影下的风险，能源安全规划者早就将这种情景标记为全球供应的最坏结果。

segments.src: Saudi officials have not publicly detailed the full scope of repairs, though statements from the kingdom's energy sector emphasize that safeguarding export infrastructure remains a top priority and that contingency measures are being activated.
segments.tr: 沙特官员尚未公开详细说明维修工作的全部范围，但该王国能源部门的声明强调，保护出口基础设施仍然是首要优先事项，应急措施正在启动。

segments.src: ## What It Means Going Forward
segments.tr: ## 展望未来

segments.src: For consumers, a sustained move toward $110 crude would likely translate into higher prices at the pump and added cost pressure across shipping, manufacturing, and travel, sectors already sensitive to energy costs.
segments.tr: 对于消费者来说，原油持续走向每桶110美元可能会导致加油站油价上升，以及运输、制造和旅游等对能源成本敏感的部门成本压力增加。

segments.src: Central banks and finance ministries in major importing economies are reportedly monitoring the situation closely given the potential knock-on effects for inflation.
segments.tr: 据报道，主要进口经济体的央行和财政部正在密切关注局势，考虑到对通胀的潜在连锁反应。

segments.src: Energy analysts caution against overreacting to early, still-developing reports, noting that oil markets have weathered supply shocks before through emergency reserve releases, output adjustments from other producers, and diplomatic de-escalation.
segments.tr: 能源分析师警告不要过度反应早期的、仍在发展中的报告，指出油市之前通过紧急储备释放、其他生产商的产量调整和外交降温度过了供应冲击。

segments.src: Even so, the combination of a disabled bypass route and a still-restricted strait marks one of the more serious tests of Gulf energy security in recent memory, and markets are likely to stay volatile until clearer information emerges on both the pipeline's repair timeline and the broader diplomatic path forward.
segments.tr: 即便如此，禁用旁通路线与仍然受限海峡的结合标志着近年来海湾能源安全最严峻的考验之一，市场可能会保持波动，直到出现关于管道维修时间表和更广泛外交前进道路的更清晰信息。

hi.title: सऊदी पाइपलाइन हमला मुख्य तेल जीवन रेखा को काटता है, कच्चे तेल को $110 प्रति बैरल की ओर ले जाता है

segments.src: ## A Critical Artery Goes Offline
segments.tr: ## एक महत्वपूर्ण धमनी ऑफ़लाइन जाती है

segments.src: Global oil markets are on edge after reports of a drone strike on Saudi Arabia's East-West Pipeline, known as Petroline, one of the few remaining routes capable of moving crude from the kingdom's eastern oil fields to export terminals on the Red Sea without passing through the Strait of Hormuz.
segments.tr: सऊदी अरब की पूर्व-पश्चिम पाइपलाइन पर ड्रोन हमले की रिपोर्ट के बाद वैश्विक तेल बाजार सतर्क हैं, जिसे पेट्रोलाइन के रूप में जाना जाता है, जो राज्य के पूर्वी तेल क्षेत्रों से होर्मुज जलडमरूमध्य से गुजरे बिना लाल सागर पर निर्यात टर्मिनलों तक कच्चे तेल को ले जाने में सक्षम कुछ शेष मार्गों में से एक है।

segments.src: Industry sources say the damage has forced Saudi authorities to scale back production and reroute shipments while repair crews assess the extent of the disruption.
segments.tr: उद्योग स्रोतों का कहना है कि क्षति ने सऊदी अधिकारियों को उत्पादन को कम करने और शिपमेंट को पुनः रूट करने के लिए मजबूर किया है जबकि मरम्मत दलें व्यवधान की सीमा का आकलन करते हैं।

segments.src: The pipeline, which under normal conditions can carry roughly five million barrels of oil and refined products per day, has long been viewed by energy planners as a strategic hedge against exactly the kind of chokepoint risk now playing out in the Strait of Hormuz, where ongoing regional conflict has already curtailed tanker traffic for weeks.
segments.tr: पाइपलाइन, जो सामान्य परिस्थितियों में प्रतिदिन लगभग पांच मिलियन बैरल तेल और परिष्कृत उत्पादों को ले जा सकता है, लंबे समय से ऊर्जा योजनाकारों द्वारा होर्मुज जलडमरूमध्य में अभी खेल रहे इसी तरह के अड़चन जोखिम के खिलाफ एक रणनीतिक बचाव के रूप में देखा जाता है, जहां चल रहे क्षेत्रीय संघर्ष ने पहले ही हफ्तों के लिए टैंकर ट्रैफिक को सीमित कर दिया है।

segments.src: With that alternate route now compromised, traders say the market is confronting the possibility that a meaningful share of Gulf export capacity could be constrained at the same time.
segments.tr: उस वैकल्पिक मार्ग के अब समझौता होने के साथ, व्यापारी कहते हैं कि बाजार इस संभावना का सामना कर रहा है कि खाड़ी निर्यात क्षमता का एक महत्वपूर्ण हिस्सा एक ही समय में प्रतिबंधित हो सकता है।

segments.src: ## Why Prices Are Reacting
segments.tr: ## कीमतें क्यों प्रतिक्रिया दे रही हैं

segments.src: Benchmark crude prices have climbed sharply on the news, with several analysts telling news outlets that a sustained outage could push prices toward the $110-a-barrel mark, a level not tested in years.
segments.tr: समाचार पर बेंचमार्क कच्चे तेल की कीमतें तेजी से बढ़ी हैं, कई विश्लेषकों ने समाचार आउटलेटों को बताया कि एक निरंतर बिजली आउटेज कीमतों को $110 प्रति बैरल के निशान की ओर ले जा सकता है, एक स्तर वर्षों में परीक्षण नहीं किया गया है।

segments.src: Energy strategists caution that figures remain fluid and will depend heavily on how quickly Saudi Arabia can restore flows, whether alternative export arrangements can absorb the shortfall, and how other OPEC+ producers respond.
segments.tr: ऊर्जा रणनीतिकार सावधान करते हैं कि आंकड़े तरल रहते हैं और सऊदी अरब कितनी तेजी से प्रवाह को बहाल कर सकता है, क्या वैकल्पिक निर्यात व्यवस्थाएं कमी को अवशोषित कर सकती हैं, और अन्य OPEC+ उत्पादक कैसे प्रतिक्रिया करते हैं, इस पर बहुत निर्भर करेंगे।

segments.src: Even so, the combination of a disabled bypass route and a still-restricted strait marks one of the more serious tests of Gulf energy security in recent memory, and markets are likely to stay volatile until clearer information emerges on both the pipeline's repair timeline and the broader diplomatic path forward.

es.title: El Ataque Al Oleoducto Saudita Corta Una Vía Vital De Petróleo, Empujando El Crudo Hacia $110 Por Barril

segments.src: ## A Critical Artery Goes Offline
segments.tr: ## Una Arteria Crítica Se Desconecta

segments.src: Global oil markets are on edge after reports of a drone strike on Saudi Arabia's East-West Pipeline, known as Petroline, one of the few remaining routes capable of moving crude from the kingdom's eastern oil fields to export terminals on the Red Sea without passing through the Strait of Hormuz.
segments.tr: Los mercados petroleros globales están en alerta máxima tras reportes de un ataque con drones al Oleoducto Este-Oeste de Arabia Saudita, conocido como Petroline, una de las pocas rutas restantes capaces de transportar crudo desde los campos petroleros orientales del reino a terminales de exportación en el Mar Rojo sin pasar por el Estrecho de Ormuz.

segments.src: Industry sources say the damage has forced Saudi authorities to scale back production and reroute shipments while repair crews assess the extent of the disruption.
segments.tr: Fuentes de la industria dicen que el daño ha obligado a las autoridades sauditas a reducir la producción y redirigir envíos mientras equipos de reparación evalúan el alcance de la interrupción.

segments.src: The pipeline, which under normal conditions can carry roughly five million barrels of oil and refined products per day, has long been viewed by energy planners as a strategic hedge against exactly the kind of chokepoint risk now playing out in the Strait of Hormuz, where ongoing regional conflict has already curtailed tanker traffic for weeks.
segments.tr: El oleoducto, que bajo condiciones normales puede transportar aproximadamente cinco millones de barriles de petróleo y productos refinados por día, ha sido visto durante mucho tiempo por los planificadores energéticos como una cobertura estratégica contra exactamente el tipo de riesgo de cuello de botella que ahora se está desarrollando en el Estrecho de Ormuz, donde el conflicto regional continuo ya ha reducido el tráfico de buques tanque durante semanas.

segments.src: With that alternate route now compromised, traders say the market is confronting the possibility that a meaningful share of Gulf export capacity could be constrained at the same time.
segments.tr: Con esa ruta alternativa ahora comprometida, los operadores dicen que el mercado se enfrenta a la posibilidad de que una parte significativa de la capacidad de exportación del Golfo podría estar restringida al mismo tiempo.

segments.src: ## Why Prices Are Reacting
segments.tr: ## Por Qué Los Precios Están Reaccionando

segments.src: Benchmark crude prices have climbed sharply on the news, with several analysts telling news outlets that a sustained outage could push prices toward the $110-a-barrel mark, a level not tested in years.
segments.tr: Los precios del crudo de referencia han subido bruscamente con la noticia, con varios analistas diciéndole a los medios de comunicación que una interrupción sostenida podría empujar los precios hacia la marca de $110 por barril, un nivel no probado en años.

segments.src: Energy strategists caution that figures remain fluid and will depend heavily on how quickly Saudi Arabia can restore flows, whether alternative export arrangements can absorb the shortfall, and how other OPEC+ producers respond.
segments.tr: Los estrategas energéticos advierten que las cifras siguen siendo fluidas y dependerán en gran medida de qué tan rápido Arabia Saudita pueda restaurar los flujos, si los arreglos de exportación alternativos pueden absorber el déficit, y cómo responden otros productores de OPEC+.

segments.src: "Markets don't just price in the barrels that are actually lost, they price in the uncertainty of what comes next," one commodities analyst said, reflecting a view echoed across trading desks this week.
segments.tr: "Los mercados no solo cotizan los barriles que realmente se pierden, cotizan la incertidumbre de lo que viene después," dijo un analista de materias primas, reflejando una perspectiva repetida en los escritorios de operaciones esta semana.

segments.src: Shipping and insurance costs for tankers in the wider region have also risen, according to maritime industry sources, adding further upward pressure on landed oil prices for importers.
segments.tr: Los costos de envío y seguro para buques tanque en la región más amplia también han aumentado, según fuentes de la industria marítima, añadiendo más presión alcista sobre los precios del petróleo de entrega para importadores.

segments.src: ## Diplomacy Stalls as Stakes Rise
segments.tr: ## La Diplomacia Se Estanca Mientras Aumentan Las Apuestas

segments.src: The incident has complicated efforts by regional and international mediators who had been working to de-escalate tensions around the Strait of Hormuz.
segments.tr: El incidente ha complicado los esfuerzos de mediadores regionales e internacionales que habían estado trabajando para desescalar las tensiones alrededor del Estrecho de Ormuz.

segments.src: Several Gulf-focused diplomatic channels have reportedly gone quiet in the immediate aftermath, as governments assess responsibility for the strike and weigh their next moves.
segments.tr: Varios canales diplomáticos enfocados en el Golfo han reportadamente quedado en silencio en el período inmediato posterior, mientras los gobiernos evalúan la responsabilidad del ataque y ponderan sus próximos movimientos.

segments.src: Analysts note that any prolonged stalemate raises the risk that both the strait and key overland pipeline routes remain under a cloud of uncertainty simultaneously, a scenario energy security planners have long flagged as a worst-case outcome for global supply.
segments.tr: Los analistas señalan que cualquier estancamiento prolongado aumenta el riesgo de que tanto el estrecho como las rutas clave de oleoductos terrestres permanezcan bajo una nube de incertidumbre simultáneamente, un escenario que los planificadores de seguridad energética han señalado durante mucho tiempo como un resultado de peor caso para el suministro global.

segments.src: Saudi officials have not publicly detailed the full scope of repairs, though statements from the kingdom's energy sector emphasize that safeguarding export infrastructure remains a top priority and that contingency measures are being activated.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios sauditas no han detallado públicamente el alcance completo de las reparaciones, aunque las declaraciones del sector energético del reino enfatizan que la protección de la infraestructura de exportación sigue siendo una prioridad máxima y que se están activando medidas de contingencia.

segments.src: ## What It Means Going Forward
segments.tr: ## Lo Que Significa De Aquí En Adelante

segments.src: For consumers, a sustained move toward $110 crude would likely translate into higher prices at the pump and added cost pressure across shipping, manufacturing, and travel, sectors already sensitive to energy costs.
segments.tr: Para los consumidores, un movimiento sostenido hacia petróleo a $110 probablemente se traduciría en precios más altos en la bomba y presión de costos adicional en envíos, manufactura y viajes, sectores ya sensibles a los costos de energía.

segments.src: Central banks and finance ministries in major importing economies are reportedly monitoring the situation closely given the potential knock-on effects for inflation.
segments.tr: Los bancos centrales y ministerios de finanzas en las principales economías importadoras reportadamente están monitoreando la situación de cerca dado los posibles efectos secundarios para la inflación.

segments.src: Energy analysts caution against overreacting to early, still-developing reports, noting that oil markets have weathered supply shocks before through emergency reserve releases, output adjustments from other producers, and diplomatic de-escalation.
segments.tr: Los analistas energéticos advierten contra reacciones exageradas a reportes tempranos aún en desarrollo, señalando que los mercados petroleros han resistido choques de suministro antes a través de liberaciones de reservas de emergencia, ajustes de producción de otros productores, y desescalada diplomática.

segments.src: Even so, the combination of a disabled bypass route and a still-restricted strait marks one of the more serious tests of Gulf energy security in recent memory, and markets are likely to stay volatile until clearer information emerges on both the pipeline's repair timeline and the broader diplomatic path forward.
segments.tr: Aun así, la combinación de una ruta de derivación deshabilitada y un estrecho aún restringido marca una de las pruebas más serias de la seguridad energética del Golfo en la memoria reciente, y es probable que los mercados se mantengan volátiles hasta que emerja información más clara tanto sobre el cronograma de reparación del oleoducto como sobre el camino diplomático más amplio hacia adelante.

segments.tr: يحذر محللو الطاقة من الإفراط في رد الفعل للتقارير المبكرة والتي لا تزال قيد التطور، مشيرين إلى أن أسواق النفط تحملت صدمات العرض من قبل من خلال إطلاقات الاحتياطيات الطارئة وتعديلات الإنتاج من المنتجين الآخرين وتخفيف التوترات الدبلوماسية.

segments.src: Even so, the combination of a disabled bypass route and a still-restricted strait marks one of the more serious tests of Gulf energy security in recent memory, and markets are likely to stay volatile until clearer information emerges on both the pipeline's repair timeline and the broader diplomatic path forward.
segments.tr: حتى الآن، فإن الجمع بين طريق جانبية معطلة وقناة لا تزال مقيدة يشكل واحداً من أكثر اختبارات أمن الطاقة الخليجية شدة في الذاكرة الأخيرة، والأسواق من المرجح أن تبقى متقلبة حتى تظهر معلومات أوضح على كل من جدول الزمني لإصلاح خط الأنابيب والمسار الدبلوماسي الأوسع للمستقبل.

fr.title: Frappe de pipeline saoudien coupe une artère pétrolière cruciale, poussant le brut vers 110 $ le baril

segments.src: ## A Critical Artery Goes Offline
segments.tr: ## Une Artère Critique Est Hors Ligne

segments.src: Global oil markets are on edge after reports of a drone strike on Saudi Arabia's East-West Pipeline, known as Petroline, one of the few remaining routes capable of moving crude from the kingdom's eastern oil fields to export terminals on the Red Sea without passing through the Strait of Hormuz.
segments.tr: Les marchés pétroliers mondiaux sont en alerte après des rapports d'une frappe de drone sur le Pipeline Est-Ouest de l'Arabie Saoudite, connu sous le nom de Petroline, l'un des rares itinéraires restants capable de transporter du brut des champs pétroliers orientaux du royaume vers les terminaux d'exportation de la mer Rouge sans passer par le détroit d'Ormuz.

segments.src: Industry sources say the damage has forced Saudi authorities to scale back production and reroute shipments while repair crews assess the extent of the disruption.
segments.tr: Les sources industrielles affirment que les dégâts ont forcé les autorités saoudiennes à réduire la production et à rediriger les expéditions tandis que les équipes de réparation évaluent l'étendue de la perturbation.

segments.src: The pipeline, which under normal conditions can carry roughly five million barrels of oil and refined products per day, has long been viewed by energy planners as a strategic hedge against exactly the kind of chokepoint risk now playing out in the Strait of Hormuz, where ongoing regional conflict has already curtailed tanker traffic for weeks.
segments.tr: Le pipeline, qui dans des conditions normales peut transporter environ cinq millions de barils de pétrole et de produits raffinés par jour, a longtemps été considéré par les planificateurs énergétiques comme une couverture stratégique contre exactement ce type de risque de goulot d'étranglement qui se manifeste maintenant dans le détroit d'Ormuz, où le conflit régional en cours a déjà réduit le trafic des pétroliers depuis des semaines.

segments.src: With that alternate route now compromised, traders say the market is confronting the possibility that a meaningful share of Gulf export capacity could be constrained at the same time.
segments.tr: Avec cet itinéraire alternatif maintenant compromis, les traders disent que le marché fait face à la possibilité qu'une part importante de la capacité d'exportation du Golfe puisse être restreinte au même moment.

segments.src: ## Why Prices Are Reacting
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les prix réagissent

segments.src: Benchmark crude prices have climbed sharply on the news, with several analysts telling news outlets that a sustained outage could push prices toward the $110-a-barrel mark, a level not tested in years.
segments.tr: Les prix du brut de référence ont augmenté fortement à la suite de cette nouvelle, avec plusieurs analystes déclarant aux médias qu'une panne prolongée pourrait pousser les prix vers le seuil de 110 $ le baril, un niveau non testé depuis des années.

segments.src: Energy strategists caution that figures remain fluid and will depend heavily on how quickly Saudi Arabia can restore flows, whether alternative export arrangements can absorb the shortfall, and how other OPEC+ producers respond.
segments.tr: Les stratèges énergétiques mettent en garde que les chiffres restent fluides et dépendront fortement de la rapidité avec laquelle l'Arabie Saoudite peut rétablir les flux, de la capacité des arrangements d'exportation alternatifs à absorber le déficit, et de la façon dont les autres producteurs de l'OPEP+ réagissent.

segments.src: "Markets don't just price in the barrels that are actually lost, they price in the uncertainty of what comes next," one commodities analyst said, reflecting a view echoed across trading desks this week.
segments.tr: « Les marchés intègrent non seulement les barils réellement perdus dans les prix, mais aussi l'incertitude de ce qui vient ensuite », a déclaré un analyste des matières premières, reflétant une vision partagée dans toutes les salles de marché cette semaine.

segments.src: Shipping and insurance costs for tankers in the wider region have also risen, according to maritime industry sources, adding further upward pressure on landed oil prices for importers.
segments.tr: Les coûts d'expédition et d'assurance des pétroliers dans la région plus large ont également augmenté, selon les sources de l'industrie maritime, ajoutant une pression supplémentaire à la hausse sur les prix du pétrole livrés pour les importateurs.

segments.src: ## Diplomacy Stalls as Stakes Rise
segments.tr: ## La diplomatie s'enlise tandis que les enjeux augmentent

segments.src: The incident has complicated efforts by regional and international mediators who had been working to de-escalate tensions around the Strait of Hormuz.
segments.tr: L'incident a compliqué les efforts des médiateurs régionaux et internationaux qui travaillaient à apaiser les tensions autour du détroit d'Ormuz.

segments.src: Several Gulf-focused diplomatic channels have reportedly gone quiet in the immediate aftermath, as governments assess responsibility for the strike and weigh their next moves.
segments.tr: Plusieurs canaux diplomatiques centrés sur le Golfe auraient gardé le silence immédiatement après, tandis que les gouvernements évaluent la responsabilité de la frappe et pèsent leurs prochains mouvements.

segments.src: Analysts note that any prolonged stalemate raises the risk that both the strait and key overland pipeline routes remain under a cloud of uncertainty simultaneously, a scenario energy security planners have long flagged as a worst-case outcome for global supply.
segments.tr: Les analystes notent que toute impasse prolongée augmente le risque que le détroit et les routes de pipeline terrestres clés restent sous un nuage d'incertitude simultanément, un scénario que les planificateurs de la sécurité énergétique ont longtemps qualifié de pire cas possible pour l'approvisionnement mondial.

segments.src: Saudi officials have not publicly detailed the full scope of repairs, though statements from the kingdom's energy sector emphasize that safeguarding export infrastructure remains a top priority and that contingency measures are being activated.
segments.tr: Les autorités saoudiennes n'ont pas détaillé publiquement l'étendue complète des réparations, bien que les déclarations du secteur énergétique du royaume soulignent que la protection de l'infrastructure d'exportation reste une priorité absolue et que des mesures d'urgence sont en cours d'activation.

segments.src: ## What It Means Going Forward
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela signifie pour l'avenir

segments.src: For consumers, a sustained move toward $110 crude would likely translate into higher prices at the pump and added cost pressure across shipping, manufacturing, and travel, sectors already sensitive to energy costs.
segments.tr: Pour les consommateurs, un mouvement soutenu vers le brut à 110 $ se traduirait probablement par des prix plus élevés à la pompe et une pression accrue sur les coûts du transport maritime, de la fabrication et des voyages, secteurs déjà sensibles aux coûts énergétiques.

segments.src: Central banks and finance ministries in major importing economies are reportedly monitoring the situation closely given the potential knock-on effects for inflation.
segments.tr: Les banques centrales et les ministères des finances des grandes économies importatrices surveilleraient de près la situation en raison des effets induits potentiels sur l'inflation.

segments.src: Energy analysts caution against overreacting to early, still-developing reports, noting that oil markets have weathered supply shocks before through emergency reserve releases, output adjustments from other producers, and diplomatic de-escalation.
segments.tr: Les analystes énergétiques mettent en garde contre la surréaction à des rapports précoces et toujours en développement, notant que les marchés pétroliers ont déjà surmonté les chocs d'approvisionnement par le biais de libérations de réserves d'urgence, d'ajustements de production d'autres producteurs et de réduction de la tension diplomatique.

segments.src: Even so, the combination of a disabled bypass route and a still-restricted strait marks one of the more serious tests of Gulf energy security in recent memory, and markets are likely to stay volatile until clearer information emerges on both the pipeline's repair timeline and the broader diplomatic path forward.
segments.tr: Même ainsi, la combinaison d'une route de contournement désactivée et d'un détroit toujours restreint marque l'une des plus graves épreuves de la sécurité énergétique du Golfe dans la mémoire récente, et les marchés sont susceptibles de rester volatiles jusqu'à ce que des informations plus claires émergent sur le calendrier de réparation du pipeline et la voie diplomatique plus large à suivre.

pt.title: Ataque ao Gasoduto Saudita Corta Linha de Vida Crucial do Petróleo, Empurrando o Óleo Bruto para US$ 110 o Barril

segments.src: ## A Critical Artery Goes Offline
segments.tr: ## Uma Artéria Crítica Sai de Operação

segments.src: Global oil markets are on edge after reports of a drone strike on Saudi Arabia's East-West Pipeline, known as Petroline, one of the few remaining routes capable of moving crude from the kingdom's eastern oil fields to export terminals on the Red Sea without passing through the Strait of Hormuz.
segments.tr: Os mercados globais de petróleo estão em alerta máximo após relatos de um ataque de drone ao Gasoduto Leste-Oeste da Arábia Saudita, conhecido como Petroline, uma das poucas rotas restantes capazes de transportar óleo bruto dos campos petrolíferos orientais do reino para terminais de exportação no Mar Vermelho sem passar pelo Estreito de Ormuz.

segments.src: Industry sources say the damage has forced Saudi authorities to scale back production and reroute shipments while repair crews assess the extent of the disruption.
segments.tr: Fontes da indústria dizem que o dano forçou as autoridades sauditas a reduzirem a produção e redirecionarem os embarques enquanto equipes de reparo avaliam a extensão da interrupção.

segments.src: The pipeline, which under normal conditions can carry roughly five million barrels of oil and refined products per day, has long been viewed by energy planners as a strategic hedge against exactly the kind of chokepoint risk now playing out in the Strait of Hormuz, where ongoing regional conflict has already curtailed tanker traffic for weeks.
segments.tr: O gasoduto, que em condições normais pode transportar aproximadamente cinco milhões de barris de óleo e produtos refinados por dia, há muito tempo é considerado por planejadores de energia como um protetor estratégico contra exatamente o tipo de risco de estrangulamento que está ocorrendo no Estreito de Ormuz, onde o conflito regional contínuo já restringiu o tráfego de navios-tanque por semanas.

segments.src: With that alternate route now compromised, traders say the market is confronting the possibility that a meaningful share of Gulf export capacity could be constrained at the same time.
segments.tr: Com essa rota alternativa agora comprometida, os operadores dizem que o mercado está enfrentando a possibilidade de que uma parcela significativa da capacidade de exportação do Golfo poderia ser restringida ao mesmo tempo.

segments.src: ## Why Prices Are Reacting
segments.tr: ## Por Que Os Preços Estão Reagindo

segments.src: Benchmark crude prices have climbed sharply on the news, with several analysts telling news outlets that a sustained outage could push prices toward the $110-a-barrel mark, a level not tested in years.
segments.tr: Os preços do óleo bruto de referência subiram acentuadamente com a notícia, com vários analistas informando aos meios de comunicação que uma interrupção sustentada poderia levar os preços para a marca de US$ 110 por barril, um nível não testado em anos.

segments.src: Energy strategists caution that figures remain fluid and will depend heavily on how quickly Saudi Arabia can restore flows, whether alternative export arrangements can absorb the shortfall, and how other OPEC+ producers respond.
segments.tr: Estrategistas energéticos alertam que as cifras permanecem fluidas e dependerão fortemente de quão rapidamente a Arábia Saudita pode restaurar os fluxos, se arranjos alternativos de exportação podem absorver o déficit e como outros produtores da OPEP+ respondem.

segments.src: "Markets don't just price in the barrels that are actually lost, they price in the uncertainty of what comes next," one commodities analyst said, reflecting a view echoed across trading desks this week.
segments.tr: "Os mercados não apenas precificam os barris que são realmente perdidos, eles precificam a incerteza do que vem a seguir," disse um analista de commodities, refletindo uma visão ecoada em mesas de negociação esta semana.

segments.src: Shipping and insurance costs for tankers in the wider region have also risen, according to maritime industry sources, adding further upward pressure on landed oil prices for importers.
segments.tr: Os custos de envio e seguro para navios-tanque na região mais ampla também aumentaram, de acordo com fontes da indústria marítima, adicionando pressão adicional para cima nos preços do óleo desembarcado para importadores.

segments.src: ## Diplomacy Stalls as Stakes Rise
segments.tr: ## Diplomacia Paralisada Enquanto as Apostas Aumentam

segments.src: The incident has complicated efforts by regional and international mediators who had been working to de-escalate tensions around the Strait of Hormuz.
segments.tr: O incidente complicou os esforços de mediadores regionais e internacionais que vinham trabalhando para desescalar as tensões em torno do Estreito de Ormuz.

segments.src: Several Gulf-focused diplomatic channels have reportedly gone quiet in the immediate aftermath, as governments assess responsibility for the strike and weigh their next moves.
segments.tr: Vários canais diplomáticos focados no Golfo ficaram silenciosos, segundo relatos, no período imediato após o incidente, enquanto os governos avaliam a responsabilidade pelo ataque e pesam seus próximos movimentos.

segments.src: Analysts note that any prolonged stalemate raises the risk that both the strait and key overland pipeline routes remain under a cloud of uncertainty simultaneously, a scenario energy security planners have long flagged as a worst-case outcome for global supply.
segments.tr: Analistas observam que qualquer impasse prolongado aumenta o risco de que tanto o estreito quanto as principais rotas de gasodutos terrestres permaneçam sob uma nuvem de incerteza simultaneamente, um cenário que planejadores de segurança energética há muito flagaram como resultado de pior caso para o fornecimento global.

segments.src: Saudi officials have not publicly detailed the full scope of repairs, though statements from the kingdom's energy sector emphasize that safeguarding export infrastructure remains a top priority and that contingency measures are being activated.
segments.tr: Autoridades sauditas não detalharam publicamente o escopo completo dos reparos, embora declarações do setor energético do reino enfatizem que a salvaguarda da infraestrutura de exportação permanece uma prioridade máxima e que medidas de contingência estão sendo ativadas.

segments.src: ## What It Means Going Forward
segments.tr: ## O Que Isso Significa Daqui para Frente

segments.src: For consumers, a sustained move toward $110 crude would likely translate into higher prices at the pump and added cost pressure across shipping, manufacturing, and travel, sectors already sensitive to energy costs.
segments.tr: Para os consumidores, um movimento sustentado em direção ao óleo bruto de US$ 110 provavelmente se traduziria em preços mais altos na bomba e pressão de custos adicional em toda a navegação, manufatura e viagens, setores já sensíveis aos custos de energia.

segments.src: Central banks and finance ministries in major importing economies are reportedly monitoring the situation closely given the potential knock-on effects for inflation.
segments.tr: Bancos centrais e ministérios das finanças em grandes economias importadoras estão, segundo relatos, monitorando a situação de perto, dado o potencial efeito cascata para a inflação.

segments.src: Energy analysts caution against overreacting to early, still-developing reports, noting that oil markets have weathered supply shocks before through emergency reserve releases, output adjustments from other producers, and diplomatic de-escalation.
segments.tr: Analistas energéticos alertam contra reações exageradas a relatórios iniciais e ainda em desenvolvimento, observando que os mercados de petróleo já enfrentaram choques de oferta antes através de liberação de reservas de emergência, ajustes de produção de outros produtores e desescalação diplomática.

segments.src: Even so, the combination of a disabled bypass route and a still-restricted strait marks one of the more serious tests of Gulf energy security in recent memory, and markets are likely to stay volatile until clearer information emerges on both the pipeline's repair timeline and the broader diplomatic path forward.
segments.tr: Ainda assim, a combinação de uma rota de desvio desativada e um estreito ainda restrito marca um dos testes mais sérios de segurança energética do Golfo em memória recente, e os mercados provavelmente permanecerão voláteis até que informações mais claras surjam tanto sobre a linha do tempo de reparo do gasoduto quanto sobre o caminho diplomático mais amplo a seguir.

in.title: Serangan Pipeline Saudi Memutus Saluran Minyak Kunci, Mendorong Minyak Mentah Menuju $110 per Barel

segments.src: ## A Critical Artery Goes Offline

segments.tr: Pasar minyak global tegang setelah laporan serangan drone pada Pipeline Timur-Barat Arab Saudi, yang dikenal sebagai Petroline, salah satu dari sedikit rute yang tersisa yang mampu memindahkan minyak mentah dari ladang minyak timur kerajaan ke terminal ekspor di Laut Merah tanpa melewati Selat Hormuz.

segments.src: Industry sources say the damage has forced Saudi authorities to scale back production and reroute shipments while repair crews assess the extent of the disruption.
segments.tr: Sumber industri mengatakan kerusakan telah memaksa otoritas Arab Saudi untuk mengurangi produksi dan mengalihkan pengiriman sementara tim perbaikan menilai luasnya gangguan.

segments.src: The pipeline, which under normal conditions can carry roughly five million barrels of oil and refined products per day, has long been viewed by energy planners as a strategic hedge against exactly the kind of chokepoint risk now playing out in the Strait of Hormuz, where ongoing regional conflict has already curtailed tanker traffic for weeks.
segments.tr: Pipeline, yang dalam kondisi normal dapat membawa kira-kira lima juta barel minyak dan produk olahan per hari, telah lama dilihat oleh perencana energi sebagai lindung nilai strategis terhadap jenis risiko titik penyempitan yang sekarang terjadi di Selat Hormuz, di mana konflik regional yang berkelanjutan telah membatasi lalu lintas kapal tangki selama berminggu-minggu.

segments.src: With that alternate route now compromised, traders say the market is confronting the possibility that a meaningful share of Gulf export capacity could be constrained at the same time.
segments.tr: Dengan rute alternatif sekarang terganggu, pedagang mengatakan pasar menghadapi kemungkinan bahwa bagian yang bermakna dari kapasitas ekspor Teluk dapat dibatasi pada saat yang sama.

segments.src: ## Why Prices Are Reacting
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Harga Bereaksi

segments.src: Benchmark crude prices have climbed sharply on the news, with several analysts telling news outlets that a sustained outage could push prices toward the $110-a-barrel mark, a level not tested in years.
segments.tr: Harga minyak mentah benchmark telah naik tajam atas berita tersebut, dengan beberapa analis memberitahu outlet berita bahwa pemadaman berkelanjutan dapat mendorong harga menuju tingkat $110 per barel, level yang tidak diuji selama bertahun-tahun.

segments.src: Energy strategists caution that figures remain fluid and will depend heavily on how quickly Saudi Arabia can restore flows, whether alternative export arrangements can absorb the shortfall, and how other OPEC+ producers respond.
segments.tr: Strategi energi memperingatkan bahwa angka tetap fleksibel dan akan sangat bergantung pada seberapa cepat Arab Saudi dapat memulihkan aliran, apakah pengaturan ekspor alternatif dapat menyerap kekurangan, dan bagaimana produsen OPEC+ lainnya merespons.

segments.src: "Markets don't just price in the barrels that are actually lost, they price in the uncertainty of what comes next," one commodities analyst said, reflecting a view echoed across trading desks this week.
segments.tr: "Pasar tidak hanya menghargai barel yang benar-benar hilang, mereka menghargai ketidakpastian apa yang akan datang," kata satu analis komoditas, mencerminkan pandangan yang bergema di seluruh meja perdagangan minggu ini.

segments.src: Shipping and insurance costs for tankers in the wider region have also risen, according to maritime industry sources, adding further upward pressure on landed oil prices for importers.
segments.tr: Biaya pengiriman dan asuransi untuk kapal tangki di wilayah yang lebih luas juga telah meningkat, menurut sumber industri maritim, menambah tekanan naik lebih lanjut pada harga minyak yang mendarat untuk importir.

segments.src: ## Diplomacy Stalls as Stakes Rise
segments.tr: ## Diplomasi Macet saat Taruhan Naik

segments.src: The incident has complicated efforts by regional and international mediators who had been working to de-escalate tensions around the Strait of Hormuz.
segments.tr: Insiden telah memperumit upaya mediator regional dan internasional yang telah bekerja untuk meredakan ketegangan di sekitar Selat Hormuz.

segments.src: Several Gulf-focused diplomatic channels have reportedly gone quiet in the immediate aftermath, as governments assess responsibility for the strike and weigh their next moves.
segments.tr: Beberapa saluran diplomatik yang berfokus pada Teluk dilaporkan telah sunyi dalam periode sesudahnya yang segera, karena pemerintah menilai tanggung jawab atas serangan dan mempertimbangkan langkah selanjutnya.

segments.src: Analysts note that any prolonged stalemate raises the risk that both the strait and key overland pipeline routes remain under a cloud of uncertainty simultaneously, a scenario energy security planners have long flagged as a worst-case outcome for global supply.
segments.tr: Analis mencatat bahwa kebuntuan yang berkepanjangan meningkatkan risiko bahwa selat dan rute pipeline darat kunci tetap berada di bawah awan ketidakpastian secara bersamaan, skenario yang telah lama ditandai oleh perencana keamanan energi sebagai hasil terburuk untuk pasokan global.

segments.src: Saudi officials have not publicly detailed the full scope of repairs, though statements from the kingdom's energy sector emphasize that safeguarding export infrastructure remains a top priority and that contingency measures are being activated.
segments.tr: Pejabat Arab Saudi tidak telah merinci secara terbuka ruang lingkup perbaikan penuh, meskipun pernyataan dari sektor energi kerajaan menekankan bahwa melindungi infrastruktur ekspor tetap menjadi prioritas utama dan bahwa langkah-langkah kontingensi sedang diaktifkan.

segments.src: ## What It Means Going Forward
segments.tr: ## Apa Artinya ke Depan

segments.src: For consumers, a sustained move toward $110 crude would likely translate into higher prices at the pump and added cost pressure across shipping, manufacturing, and travel, sectors already sensitive to energy costs.
segments.tr: Bagi konsumen, langkah berkelanjutan menuju minyak mentah $110 mungkin akan diterjemahkan ke harga yang lebih tinggi di pompa dan tekanan biaya tambahan di seluruh pengiriman, manufaktur, dan perjalanan, sektor yang sudah sensitif terhadap biaya energi.

segments.src: Central banks and finance ministries in major importing economies are reportedly monitoring the situation closely given the potential knock-on effects for inflation.
segments.tr: Bank sentral dan kementerian keuangan di ekonomi pengimpor utama dilaporkan memantau situasi dengan cermat mengingat potensi efek samping untuk inflasi.

segments.src: Energy analysts caution against overreacting to early, still-developing reports, noting that oil markets have weathered supply shocks before through emergency reserve releases, output adjustments from other producers, and diplomatic de-escalation.
segments.tr: Analis energi memperingatkan terhadap bereaksi berlebihan terhadap laporan awal yang masih berkembang, mencatat bahwa pasar minyak telah menghadapi guncangan pasokan sebelumnya melalui pelepasan cadangan darurat, penyesuaian keluaran dari produsen lain, dan de-eskalasi diplomatik.

segments.src: Even so, the combination of a disabled bypass route and a still-restricted strait marks one of the more serious tests of Gulf energy security in recent memory, and markets are likely to stay volatile until clearer information emerges on both the pipeline's repair timeline and the broader diplomatic path forward.
segments.tr: Meski demikian, kombinasi rute bypass yang dinonaktifkan dan selat yang masih dibatasi menandai salah satu tes keamanan energi Teluk yang lebih serius dalam ingatan baru-baru ini, dan pasar mungkin tetap bergejolak sampai informasi yang lebih jelas muncul tentang jadwal perbaikan pipeline dan jalan diplomatik yang lebih luas ke depan.

segments.src: The pipeline, which under normal conditions can carry roughly five million barrels of oil and refined products per day, has long been viewed by energy planners as a strategic hedge against exactly the kind of chokepoint risk now playing out in the Strait of Hormuz, where ongoing regional conflict has already curtailed tanker traffic for weeks.
segments.tr: 通常時に1日あたり約500万バレルの石油・精製製品を輸送できるこのパイプラインは、エネルギー計画者によって長く、ホルムズ海峡で現在展開している窒息点リスクに対する戦略的ヘッジと見なされてきた。その海峡では、継続中の地域紛争がすでに数週間タンカー交通を制限している。

segments.src: With that alternate route now compromised, traders say the market is confronting the possibility that a meaningful share of Gulf export capacity could be constrained at the same time.
segments.tr: その代替ルートが今や機能できない状況で、トレーダーらは、市場が湾岐の相当な積出容量が同時に制約される可能性に直面していると述べている。

segments.src: ## Why Prices Are Reacting
segments.tr: ## 価格がなぜ反応しているのか

segments.src: Benchmark crude prices have climbed sharply on the news, with several analysts telling news outlets that a sustained outage could push prices toward the $110-a-barrel mark, a level not tested in years.
segments.tr: ベンチマーク原油価格はこのニュースで急騰し、複数のアナリストが、継続的な供給停止により価格が1バレル110ドル水準に達する可能性があると指摘している。これはここ数年間見られていない水準である。

segments.src: Energy strategists caution that figures remain fluid and will depend heavily on how quickly Saudi Arabia can restore flows, whether alternative export arrangements can absorb the shortfall, and how other OPEC+ producers respond.
segments.tr: エネルギー戦略家らは、数字は流動的であり、サウジアラビアがいかに迅速にフローを回復できるか、代替的な積出手段が不足分を吸収できるか、そして他のOPEC+生産国がどのように対応するかに大きく左右されると警告している。

segments.src: "Markets don't just price in the barrels that are actually lost, they price in the uncertainty of what comes next," one commodities analyst said, reflecting a view echoed across trading desks this week.
segments.tr: 「市場は実際に失われるバレルの価格を付けるだけではなく、次に何が起きるかの不確実性に価格を付ける」とある商品アナリストは述べ、今週中に取引デスク全体で共有された見方を反映している。

segments.src: Shipping and insurance costs for tankers in the wider region have also risen, according to maritime industry sources, adding further upward pressure on landed oil prices for importers.
segments.tr: 海運業界筋によると、広域地域におけるタンカーの運送・保険コストも上昇しており、輸入国の陸揚げ原油価格にさらなる上昇圧力を加えている。

segments.src: ## Diplomacy Stalls as Stakes Rise
segments.tr: ## 利害の高まりの中で外交が停滞

segments.src: The incident has complicated efforts by regional and international mediators who had been working to de-escalate tensions around the Strait of Hormuz.
segments.tr: この事件により、ホルムズ海峡周辺の緊張を緩和するために働いていた地域・国際仲介者の取り組みが複雑化した。

segments.src: Several Gulf-focused diplomatic channels have reportedly gone quiet in the immediate aftermath, as governments assess responsibility for the strike and weigh their next moves.
segments.tr: 複数の湾岐に焦点を当てた外交チャネルが直後に静寂状態に入ったと報告されており、政府が爆撃の責任を評価し、次の動きを検討している。

segments.src: Analysts note that any prolonged stalemate raises the risk that both the strait and key overland pipeline routes remain under a cloud of uncertainty simultaneously, a scenario energy security planners have long flagged as a worst-case outcome for global supply.
segments.tr: アナリストは、いかなる長期的な膠着状態も、海峡と主要な陸路パイプラインルートの両方が同時に不確実性の雲の下に留まるリスクを高めると指摘しており、これはエネルギー安全保障計画者が長く、世界的な供給に対する最悪シナリオとして指摘してきた状況である。

segments.src: Saudi officials have not publicly detailed the full scope of repairs, though statements from the kingdom's energy sector emphasize that safeguarding export infrastructure remains a top priority and that contingency measures are being activated.
segments.tr: サウジアラビア当局は修復の全体的な範囲を公開していないが、同国のエネルギー部門からの声明は、積出インフラの保護が最優先事項であり、応急対応措置が実施されていることを強調している。

segments.src: ## What It Means Going Forward
segments.tr: ## 今後の意味するところ

segments.src: For consumers, a sustained move toward $110 crude would likely translate into higher prices at the pump and added cost pressure across shipping, manufacturing, and travel, sectors already sensitive to energy costs.
segments.tr: 消費者にとって、原油が1バレル110ドル水準への継続的な上昇は、給油所でのガソリン価格上昇と配送・製造・旅行セクター全体でのコスト圧力上昇につながる可能性が高く、これらのセクターはすでにエネルギーコストに敏感である。

segments.src: Central banks and finance ministries in major importing economies are reportedly monitoring the situation closely given the potential knock-on effects for inflation.
segments.tr: 主要輸入国の中央銀行と財務省は、インフレーションへの潜在的な波及効果を考慮して、状況を注視していると報告されている。

segments.src: Energy analysts caution against overreacting to early, still-developing reports, noting that oil markets have weathered supply shocks before through emergency reserve releases, output adjustments from other producers, and diplomatic de-escalation.
segments.tr: エネルギーアナリストは初期の、まだ詳細が明らかになっていない報告に過剰反応することに対して警告し、石油市場が以前に、緊急備蓄放出、他の生産国からの生産調整、および外交的な緊張緩和を通じて供給ショックを乗り切ったことを指摘している。

segments.src: Even so, the combination of a disabled bypass route and a still-restricted strait marks one of the more serious tests of Gulf energy security in recent memory, and markets are likely to stay volatile until clearer information emerges on both the pipeline's repair timeline and the broader diplomatic path forward.
segments.tr: それでも、無効化されたバイパスルートと依然として制限された海峡の組み合わせは、最近の記憶における湾岐エネルギー安全保障のより深刻なテストの一つであり、パイプラインの修復タイムラインと、より広い外交的な前進路の両方についてより明確な情報が出現するまで、市場は変動し続ける可能性が高い。

de.title: Saudischer Pipeline-Anschlag unterbricht kritische Ölleitung und treibt Rohöl auf $110 pro Barrel

segments.src: ## A Critical Artery Goes Offline
segments.tr: ## Eine kritische Versorgungsader fällt aus

segments.src: Global oil markets are on edge after reports of a drone strike on Saudi Arabia's East-West Pipeline, known as Petroline, one of the few remaining routes capable of moving crude from the kingdom's eastern oil fields to export terminals on the Red Sea without passing through the Strait of Hormuz.
segments.tr: Die globalen Ölmärkte sind angespannt nach Berichten über einen Drohnenanschlag auf die Ost-West-Pipeline Saudi-Arabiens, bekannt als Petroline, eine der wenigen verbleibenden Routen, auf denen Rohöl aus den östlichen Ölfeldern des Königreichs zu Exportterminals am Roten Meer transportiert werden kann, ohne die Straße von Hormuz zu passieren.

segments.src: Industry sources say the damage has forced Saudi authorities to scale back production and reroute shipments while repair crews assess the extent of the disruption.
segments.tr: Industriequellen berichten, dass der Schaden die saudischen Behörden gezwungen hat, die Produktion zu reduzieren und Lieferungen umzuleiten, während Reparaturteams das Ausmaß der Störung bewerten.

segments.src: The pipeline, which under normal conditions can carry roughly five million barrels of oil and refined products per day, has long been viewed by energy planners as a strategic hedge against exactly the kind of chokepoint risk now playing out in the Strait of Hormuz, where ongoing regional conflict has already curtailed tanker traffic for weeks.
segments.tr: Die Pipeline, die unter normalen Bedingungen etwa fünf Millionen Barrel Öl und raffinierte Produkte pro Tag befördern kann, wurde von Energiefachleuten lange Zeit als strategische Absicherung gegen genau die Art von Engpass-Risiken angesehen, die sich derzeit in der Straße von Hormuz abspielt, wo anhaltende regionale Konflikte den Tankerschiffsverkehr bereits seit Wochen eingedämmt haben.

segments.src: With that alternate route now compromised, traders say the market is confronting the possibility that a meaningful share of Gulf export capacity could be constrained at the same time.
segments.tr: Angesichts der Beeinträchtigung dieser Alternativroute sagen Händler, dass sich der Markt der Möglichkeit gegenübersieht, dass ein wesentlicher Teil der Exportkapazität des Golfs gleichzeitig eingeschränkt werden könnte.

segments.src: ## Why Prices Are Reacting
segments.tr: ## Warum die Preise reagieren

segments.src: Benchmark crude prices have climbed sharply on the news, with several analysts telling news outlets that a sustained outage could push prices toward the $110-a-barrel mark, a level not tested in years.
segments.tr: Die Benchmark-Rohölpreise sind nach der Nachricht stark gestiegen, und mehrere Analysten teilten Nachrichtenmedien mit, dass ein anhaltender Ausfall die Preise auf die $110-pro-Barrel-Marke treiben könnte, ein Niveau, das seit Jahren nicht mehr getestet wurde.

segments.src: Energy strategists caution that figures remain fluid and will depend heavily on how quickly Saudi Arabia can restore flows, whether alternative export arrangements can absorb the shortfall, and how other OPEC+ producers respond.
segments.tr: Energiestrategen warnen davor, dass die Zahlen im Fluss bleiben und stark davon abhängen, wie schnell Saudi-Arabien die Ströme wiederherstellen kann, ob alternative Exportmaßnahmen das Defizit ausgleichen können und wie andere OPEC+-Produzenten reagieren.

segments.src: "Markets don't just price in the barrels that are actually lost, they price in the uncertainty of what comes next," one commodities analyst said, reflecting a view echoed across trading desks this week.
segments.tr: "Märkte berücksichtigen nicht nur die Barrel, die tatsächlich verloren gehen, sie berücksichtigen die Unsicherheit über das, was als Nächstes kommt," sagte ein Rohstoffanalyst, was eine Ansicht widerspiegelt, die diese Woche an Handelsschaltern wiederholt wurde.

segments.src: Shipping and insurance costs for tankers in the wider region have also risen, according to maritime industry sources, adding further upward pressure on landed oil prices for importers.
segments.tr: Versand- und Versicherungskosten für Tanker in der weiteren Region sind ebenfalls gestiegen, so Quellen aus der Schifffahrtsindustrie, was zusätzlichen Aufwärtsdruck auf die Landungsölpreise für Importeure ausübt.

segments.src: ## Diplomacy Stalls as Stakes Rise
segments.tr: ## Diplomatie stagniert, während die Einsätze steigen

segments.src: The incident has complicated efforts by regional and international mediators who had been working to de-escalate tensions around the Strait of Hormuz.
segments.tr: Der Vorfall hat die Bemühungen regionaler und internationaler Vermittler erschwert, die an der Deeskalation von Spannungen um die Straße von Hormuz arbeiteten.

segments.src: Several Gulf-focused diplomatic channels have reportedly gone quiet in the immediate aftermath, as governments assess responsibility for the strike and weigh their next moves.
segments.tr: Mehrere golfzentrierte diplomatische Kanäle sind Berichten zufolge unmittelbar danach verstummt, da Regierungen die Verantwortung für den Anschlag bewerten und ihre nächsten Schritte abwägen.

segments.src: Analysts note that any prolonged stalemate raises the risk that both the strait and key overland pipeline routes remain under a cloud of uncertainty simultaneously, a scenario energy security planners have long flagged as a worst-case outcome for global supply.
segments.tr: Analysten weisen darauf hin, dass jede prolongierte Sackgasse das Risiko erhöht, dass sowohl die Straße als auch wichtige Landpipeline-Routen gleichzeitig unter einer Wolke der Unsicherheit bleiben, ein Szenario, das Planer der Energiesicherheit lange Zeit als Worst-Case-Ergebnis für die globale Versorgung gekennzeichnet haben.

segments.src: Saudi officials have not publicly detailed the full scope of repairs, though statements from the kingdom's energy sector emphasize that safeguarding export infrastructure remains a top priority and that contingency measures are being activated.
segments.tr: Saudische Beamte haben den vollständigen Umfang der Reparaturen nicht öffentlich erläutert, obwohl Erklärungen aus dem Energiesektor des Königreichs betonen, dass der Schutz der Exportinfrastruktur eine Top-Priorität bleibt und dass Notfallmaßnahmen aktiviert werden.

segments.src: ## What It Means Going Forward
segments.tr: ## Was es für die Zukunft bedeutet

segments.src: For consumers, a sustained move toward $110 crude would likely translate into higher prices at the pump and added cost pressure across shipping, manufacturing, and travel, sectors already sensitive to energy costs.
segments.tr: Für Verbraucher würde eine anhaltende Bewegung in Richtung $110 Rohöl wahrscheinlich zu höheren Preisen an der Zapfsäule und zusätzlichem Kostendruck bei Versand, Herstellung und Reisen führen, Sektoren, die bereits gegenüber Energiekosten empfindlich sind.

segments.src: Central banks and finance ministries in major importing economies are reportedly monitoring the situation closely given the potential knock-on effects for inflation.
segments.tr: Zentralbanken und Finanzministerien in großen importierenden Volkswirtschaften überwachen die Situation Berichten zufolge genau, angesichts der möglichen Auswirkungen auf die Inflation.

segments.src: Energy analysts caution against overreacting to early, still-developing reports, noting that oil markets have weathered supply shocks before through emergency reserve releases, output adjustments from other producers, and diplomatic de-escalation.
segments.tr: Energieanalysten warnen davor, auf frühe, sich noch entwickelnde Berichte zu überreagieren, und weisen darauf hin, dass Ölmärkte Angebotsschocks in der Vergangenheit durch Notfall-Reservefreigaben, Leistungsanpassungen anderer Produzenten und diplomatische Deeskalation überstanden haben.

segments.src: Even so, the combination of a disabled bypass route and a still-restricted strait marks one of the more serious tests of Gulf energy security in recent memory, and markets are likely to stay volatile until clearer information emerges on both the pipeline's repair timeline and the broader diplomatic path forward.
segments.tr: Dennoch markiert die Kombination aus einer deaktivierten Umgehungsroute und einer noch immer eingeschränkten Straße einen der ernsteren Tests der Energiesicherheit des Golfs in jüngster Erinnerung, und die Märkte werden wahrscheinlich volatil bleiben, bis klarere Informationen sowohl über den Reparaturzeitplan der Pipeline als auch über den breiteren diplomatischen Weg nach vorne vorliegen.

segments.tr: Đường ống này, trong điều kiện bình thường có thể vận chuyển khoảng năm triệu thùng dầu và các sản phẩm được tinh chế mỗi ngày, từ lâu đã được các nhà lập kế hoạch năng lượng coi là một biện pháp phòng chống chính xác loại rủi ro thắt cổ chai mà hiện đang diễn ra ở Eo biển Hormuz, nơi xung đột khu vực liên tục đã giảm lưu lượng tàu chở dầu trong nhiều tuần.

segments.src: Energy strategists caution that figures remain fluid and will depend heavily on how quickly Saudi Arabia can restore flows, whether alternative export arrangements can absorb the shortfall, and how other OPEC+ producers respond.

segments.tr: ## Ngoại Giao Chậm Lại Khi Cược Tăng

segments.tr: Sự cố đã làm phức tạp các nỗ lực của các trung gian khu vực và quốc tế những người đã làm việc để giảm căng thẳng xung quanh Eo biển Hormuz.

segments.src: Several Gulf-focused diplomatic channels have reportedly gone quiet in the immediate aftermath, as governments assess responsibility for the strike and weigh their next moves.
segments.tr: Một số kênh ngoại giao tập trung vào Vùng Vịnh được cho là đã yên tĩnh lại ngay sau sự cố, khi các chính phủ đánh giá trách nhiệm cho vụ tấn công và cân nhắc các bước tiếp theo của họ.

segments.src: Analysts note that any prolonged stalemate raises the risk that both the strait and key overland pipeline routes remain under a cloud of uncertainty simultaneously, a scenario energy security planners have long flagged as a worst-case outcome for global supply.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích lưu ý rằng bất kỳ bế tắc kéo dài nào cũng tăng nguy cơ cả eo biển và các tuyến đường ống cơ sở hạ tầng quan trọng vẫn nằm dưới một đám mây bất định cùng lúc, một kịch bản mà các nhà lập kế hoạch bảo mật năng lượng đã lâu phát hiện như một kết quả tồi tệ nhất cho cung cấp toàn cầu.

segments.src: ## What It Means Going Forward

segments.src: For consumers, a sustained move toward $110 crude would likely translate into higher prices at the pump and added cost pressure across shipping, manufacturing, and travel, sectors already sensitive to energy costs.

segments.src: Central banks and finance ministries in major importing economies are reportedly monitoring the situation closely given the potential knock-on effects for inflation.
segments.tr: Các ngân hàng trung ương và bộ tài chính trong các nền kinh tế nhập khẩu chính được báo cáo là đang theo dõi tình huống chặt chẽ do các tác động dây chuyền tiềm ẩn đối với lạm phát.

segments.src: Energy analysts caution against overreacting to early, still-developing reports, noting that oil markets have weathered supply shocks before through emergency reserve releases, output adjustments from other producers, and diplomatic de-escalation.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích năng lượng cảnh báo chống lại phản ứng quá mức với các báo cáo sơ kỳ, vẫn đang phát triển, lưu ý rằng thị trường dầu đã vượt qua các cú sốc cung cấp trước đây thông qua việc phát hành dự trữ khẩn cấp, điều chỉnh sản lượng từ các nhà sản xuất khác, và giảm căng thẳng ngoại giao.

segments.src: Even so, the combination of a disabled bypass route and a still-restricted strait marks one of the more serious tests of Gulf energy security in recent memory, and markets are likely to stay volatile until clearer information emerges on both the pipeline's repair timeline and the broader diplomatic path forward.
segments.tr: Tuy vậy, sự kết hợp của một tuyến đường vòng bị vô hiệu hóa và một eo biển vẫn bị hạn chế đánh dấu một trong những bài kiểm tra nghiêm trọng hơn của an ninh năng lượng Vùng Vịnh trong bộ nhớ gần đây, và thị trường có thể sẽ ở lại biến động cho đến khi thông tin rõ ràng hơn xuất hiện trên cả lịch trình sửa chữa đường ống và đường đi ngoại giao rộng hơn phía trước.
